title: Mobile / Launch screen
slide_intent: Reduce the identity to a clear opening signal so a small screen can establish recognition immediately.
strategic_value: A centered Twitch signature on purple can connect app entry with the wider brand vocabulary.
demonstration: A phone mockup shows the white-and-black Twitch wordmark centered on a solid purple screen, surrounded by a bright gradient.
practical_value: Compare the focused in-app launch treatment with the more varied external presentation background.

content_islands.name: Phone
content_islands.spec: Center the device upright and keep the wordmark isolated on its purple screen.

content_islands.name: External gradient
content_islands.spec: Surround the phone with the case-study color field; do not treat it as part of the app UI.

reference_purposes.Application: The signature appears on a mobile launch screen.
